items.raw_excerpt: Farkhunda Hashimy moved to Saskatoon with her family in 2023, escaping the Taliban regime in Afghanistan. Decrees by the regime have restricted the rights and freedoms of Afghan women and girls, and stopped them from pursuing high education and careers.
items.summary_en: Farkhunda Hashimy moved to Saskatoon with her family in 2023 to escape the Taliban regime in Afghanistan. The regime has restricted women's rights and freedoms, stopping them from pursuing education and careers. She reflects on starting a new chapter in Canada.
items.summary_ko: 하키아 하시미는 탈레반 정권을 피해 가족과 함께 2023년 새스커툰으로 이주했습니다. 정권은 아프간 여성의 권리와 자유를 제한하고 고등교육과 경력 추구를 막았습니다. 그녀는 캐나다에서의 새로운 시작을 돌아보고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Afghan refugee reflects on new life in Saskatoon after five years

items.raw_excerpt: The exceptional feat, completed by Naucalpan native Gerardo “Coloso” Rojano Galván, established a new record in the men’s individual cross-country category for cyclists aged 18 to 49 certified by the World Ultra-Cycling Association (WUCA).
items.summary_en: Gerardo Rojano Galvan from Naucalpan, Mexico set a new cycling record for crossing the entire country by bike. The feat was certified by the World Ultra-Cycling Association in the men's cross-country category for ages 18 to 49.

items.raw_excerpt: The Order of Doctors has welcomed the delay of the new National System for Access to Consultation and Surgery, pointing towards the fact there were still many missing features that could compromise access for users of the health system.
items.summary_en: Portugal's doctors' group has welcomed the delay of a new national digital system for surgery waiting lists. The system still has many missing features that could hurt access for patients using the health service.

items.raw_excerpt: A quilt is on display at a local museum, commemorating the frontline workers who worked through the COVID-19 pandemic and memorializing those who suffered because of it.
